proposition: Kātibī's poems call Ibn Turka the 'shoot of purity' and the succourer of the Folk of Sincerity (muʿīn-i ahl-i ṣafā), and MK reads his three associations of Ibn Turka with ṣafā as almost certainly referring to the Ikhwān al-Ṣafāʾ network.

mediation.who: Kātibī Turshīzī's divan (Ankara MS Milli A.6869/3)

mediation.note: the identification with the Ikhwān is MK's 'almost certainly'
